Subject: Your cheque bounce matter

Dear Ms. Chauhan,

Thank you for meeting us on 29/11/2022 about your dispute with M/s DSouza Enterprises. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Mysuru.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Mysuru
